import cv2, numpy as np

img15 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0015.png')

b, g, r = img15[:,:,0], img15[:,:,1], img15[:,:,2]

# Chair 1 in obs 15:
mask_c1 = (r > 80) & (r < 150) & (g > 35) & (g < 80) & (b < 50) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] >= 300)
yc, xc = np.where(mask_c1)
